question:
Find the volume of a cone whose radius is 7 inches and height is 27 inches,

(Use pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 7 inches

Height (h) = 27 inches

π = 22/7

**Concept:**

Volume of a Cone, V = 1/3πr²h

**Solution:**

⇒ V = 1/3 × (22/7) × (7 inches)² × 27 inches

⇒ V = (1/3)π × (7 inches)² ×(27 inches)

⇒ V = (1/3)π × (49 square inches) × (27 inches)

⇒ V = 22 × 7 × 9

⇒ V = 1386 inches3

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
